INSERT INTO bookings (client_id, vessel_id, booking_date, status, notes, created_at, updated_at)
SELECT 
  c.id,
  v.id,
  1738281600000, -- 30/01/2026 10:00:00 GMT-3 = timestamp
  'confirmed',
  'Reserva de teste para validar correção do bug',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
FROM clients c
CROSS JOIN vessels v
WHERE c.email = 'laecio.silversat@gmail.com'
  AND v.name = 'Focker 215 150HP'
LIMIT 1;
